'''Constanten''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the final decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Constanten was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] woman who had received formal [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] before passing her [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Trials of Knighthood]] an obtaining the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. During her service to the Republic, Constanten was assigned to the planet [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], where on one occasion, she saved the life of a [[Tarasin]]. Her rescue of this woman was such a profound event in the Tarasin's life that she named [[Constanten (Tarasin)|her child]] Constanten in honor of the Jedi's heroism.<ref name="AMA" />
